title: Ichi the Witch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where only women are thought able to wield magic, Ichi, a feral boy from Druid Mountain who hunts only to eat or to protect, absorbs the Majik King Uroro and becomes the first male witch. Bound to the powerful witch Desscaras by a blood oath, he hunts Majiks that harm humans, while a prophecy says he alone can stop the World-Hater Majik at the cost of his life.
life_message: It holds up a life of honest strength, loyalty to a chosen family and taking only what one needs.

content.note: Monster hunts and killings, a Majik filleted, impalings, a village wiped out (Wikipedia; SLJ notes constant danger).
Reanimated zombies, mass deaths at sea, a doom prophecy over Ichi (Wikipedia; SLJ).
None noted in Wikipedia or SLJ; mostly female cast (to verify).
A Majik spreads despair that drives victims toward suicide; a character sees a vision of suicide (Wikipedia only; to verify).

personified.ideology: Take only what one needs; hunt only to eat or protect

delivery.note: Ichi's hunter ethic is shown in action; Majiks that harm people are opposed, though the story leaves room for coexistence.

winners_losers: Ichi and the witches who protect humans win sympathy; Majiks that harm people are the losers, though the story leaves room for coexistence. A hunter's practical, nature-bound worldview gets the most sympathy.
